info.name: Cliniccards API Documentation
info.description:
This API is available at https://cliniccards.com/api

The API allows to get information from Cliniccards. To work with the API you should get an API key. It is available only for the clinic's owner.

Go to Settings - Other - Clinic Settings - API key.

After receiving, the key is saved in the clinic’s settings. You can delete it or generate a new one.

Each request must contain 2 required headers:

  • Token - your API key

  • Content-Type - application/json

Error Handling

Each response has the "result" variable. It can have value "success" or "fail". If an error occurs, there will be a description in the “error” variable.

Example:

{"data":null,"result":"fail","error":"Body for request is empty or has incorrect JSON"}

Limits

60 requests per minute.

request.description:
Add a new doctor's appointment to the schedule.

Body Parameters

status "string" REQUIRED

Specifies the visit status.

One of: PLANNED, CONFIRMED,NOT_CONFIRMED,VISITED, MOVED,DID_NOT_COME,IN_CLINIC, BOOKING,CANCELLED, IN_CHAIR

patient_id "string" REQUIRED

Specifies the patient ID.

cabinet_id "string" REQUIRED

Specifies the cabinet ID.

doctor_id "string" REQUIRED

Specifies the doctor ID.

note "string" REQUIRED

Specifies a comment. String length from 1 to 400.

date "string" REQUIRED

Specifies the visit date. Must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.

time_start "string" REQUIRED

Specifies the start time. Must be in HH:MM format, multiples of 5 minutes.

time_end "string" REQUIRED

Specifies the end time. Must be in HH:MM format, multiples of 5 minutes.

request.description:
Add a new patient to the clinic.

Body Parameters

lastname "string" REQUIRED

Specifies the last name. String length from 1 to 50.

firstname "string" REQUIRED

Specifies the first name. String length from 1 to 50.

source "string"

Specifies the patient's source. Sources are configured at https://cliniccards.com/cabinet#patients-sources
A null value resets the field.

patient_recommendation_id "int"

If the clinic has configured "Patient's recommendations" as a source, this field can be passed instead of the source field. A valid patient ID must be passed, and source automatically becomes "Patient's recommendations".

phone "string"

Specifies the primary phone number. Must be in international format (without a + sign).

Non-numeric characters will be removed.

Default: null

phone2 "string"

Specifies the additional phone number.

discount "string"

Specifies a discount. Will be converted to a float.

Default: null

address "string"

Specifies the address. String length from 1 to 150.

email "string"

Specifies an email. Must be in valid email format.

gender "string"

Specifies gender.

One of: M or F

Default: null

important_note "string"

Specifies important information about the patient (for example, allergies). String length from 1 to 200.

note "string"

Specifies a comment.

birthday "string"

Specifies the date of birth. Must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Default: null

curator_id "string"

Specifies the doctor ID the patient is assigned to.

Default: null

date_created "string"

Specifies the date of creation. Must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Default: the current date.

preferred_contact "string"

Specifies the preferred contact.

One of: PHONE, SMS, EMAIL, VIBER, WHATSAPP, FACEBOOK, INSTAGRAM, TELEGRAM

Default: null

payer "string"

Specifies the payer.

statuses [array]

Specifies a status. An array of numbers.

Default: the first status from the clinic will be added.

code "string"

Specifies the card number. Depends on the clinic settings. If the clinic has automatic numbering enabled and this field is empty, a new number will be generated. If a number is specified, it will be checked for uniqueness.

subclinic_id "string"

Specifies clinics tag.

request.description:
Create an invoice

Required fields

  • subcategory_id — integer. Expense subcategory ID

  • supplier_id — integer. Supplier ID. Required for non-salary expenses

  • amount — float. Invoice amount. Must be greater than 0

  • date_issued — string. Date in YYYY-MM-DD format

Optional fields

  • note — string or null. Comment or note

  • clinic_member_id — integer or null. Employee ID. Required for salary spendings

  • period_start — string or null. Period start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

  • period_end — string or null. Period end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

  • is_returning — integer or null. Marks spending as return:

    • 1 = yes

    • 0 or null = no

  • subclinic_id — integer or null. Branch/subclinic ID

  • cash_desk_id — integer or null. Cash desk ID. Required when payment_amount is provided

  • payment_amount — float or null. Payment amount. Supports partial payment

  • rate — mostly null or float. Currency exchange rate. May be required when payment is created using a cash desk with a foreign currency

Payment behavior

  • If payment_amount is provided, both cash_desk_id and rate are required

  • If payment_amount is omitted or null, the expense remains unpaid

  • Partial payment is supported (payment_amount < amount)
